# ── Prerequisites ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# .secrets file (gitignored):
AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=test
AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=test
AWS_REGION=us-east-1
KUBECONFIG_B64=<see below>
POSTGRES_CONNECTION_URI=postgresql://mle_migrations:mle_migrations@<rds_address>:5432/main?sslmode=disable

# Generate KUBECONFIG_B64 (PowerShell):
$b64 = [Convert]::ToBase64String([IO.File]::ReadAllBytes(".\platform-gitops\kubeconfig\k3s.yaml"))
Add-Content .secrets "KUBECONFIG_B64=$b64"

# Get rds_address:
cd platform-gitops && terraform output -raw aws_rds_db_address

# ── Run individual workflows ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
# CI: lint + build fraud_detection image
act push --network ministack_network -W .github/workflows/ci-fraud-api.yml --secret-file .secrets

# CI: lint + build drift_monitor image
act push --network ministack_network -W .github/workflows/ci-drift-monitor.yml --secret-file .secrets

# CI: lint + build training_pipeline image
act push --network ministack_network -W .github/workflows/ci-training-pipeline.yml --secret-file .secrets

# CI: lint + build archiving image
act push --network ministack_network -W .github/workflows/ci-archiving.yml --secret-file .secrets

# CI: atlas lint (non-main branch — lint only)
act push --network ministack_network -W .github/workflows/ci-atlas.yml --secret-file .secrets

# CI: atlas lint + apply (simulate main push)
act push --network ministack_network -W .github/workflows/ci-atlas.yml --secret-file .secrets \
     -e '{"ref":"refs/heads/main"}'

# CD: deploy fraud_detection (sync secret + helm upgrade)
act push --network ministack_network -W .github/workflows/cd-fraud-api.yml --secret-file .secrets

# CD: sync DAGs to S3 + refresh mle-pipeline-secret
act push --network ministack_network -W .github/workflows/cd-dags.yml --secret-file .secrets

# CD: rotate a credential (example: rotate fraud-api POSTGRES_PASSWORD)
act workflow_dispatch --network ministack_network -W .github/workflows/cd-secret-rotation.yml \
     --secret-file .secrets \
     -e '{"inputs":{"target":"fraud-api","secret_key":"POSTGRES_PASSWORD","new_secret_value":"newpass123"}}'

# ── List all detected workflows ───────────────────────────────────────────────
act -l
